questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Columbia University er kendt for at være mere praktiske i deres tilgang til filmstudier, hvilket tiltalte mig meget, fordi jeg gerne har ville prøve yderligere kræfter med det jeg har lært på Københavns Universitet. Desuden var det vigtigt for mig at rejse til et universitet, der havde et højt akademisk niveau, hvilket man må sige Barnard College og Columbia University har. Desuden synes jeg at universitets placering i New York gav enormt god mening for de fag, jeg valgte.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Vejlederne var meget svære at komme i kontakt med og kunne desværre kun svare på generelle spørgsmål. Så det var en smule svært at få svar på de spørgsmål man havde under rejsen.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Vi havde et introforløb i to dage og derefter var man meget overladt til sig selv og spørge andre, men det var egentligt fint nok, fordi man også bare gerne ville i gang. Til gengæld var det super svært at få de fag man gerne ville, hvilket var noget, der havde været rart at være informeret om på forhånd. Konceptet "Shopping Week" måtte gerne have været uddybet til vores afrejsemøde hos KU, da dette var en meget stressende og kaotisk oplevelse.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Undervejs opstod der demonstrationer på Columbia University. KU har ikke på noget tidspunkt forsøgt at komme i kontakt med os i modsætning til journalister fra EkstraBladet og DR. Desuden oplevede vi at KU ikke svarede på vores mails i den periode. Det var meget at navigere i, eftersom vores udvekslingsophold to en meget uventet drejning, da store dele af skolen lukkede ned. Det havde været dejligt med en guideline for, hvordan man skulle forholde sig.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Double rooms med en værelseskammerat.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Der var mange kantiner omkring på Campus.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer: At der er ret beskidt og at det ikke er uvant at få skadedyrsbekæmpere over et par gange i løbet af semesteret. Ligesom at amerikanere er ret dårlige til at gøre rent.

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det var en meget lang proces. Først skulle man skrive en motiveret ansøgning og sende sine karakterer, samt sprogtest med, så skulle man vente ret lang tid på at få svar. Så skulle man i gang med sin VISA-ansøgning og i den proces skulle man få ens host institution til at lave et bank statement. Den del af processen var ret stressende. Dertil skulle man efterfølgende uploade en del dokumenter til Barnard, såsom ens vaccinationer mm.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Det var meget svært at få svar på spørgsmål fra Barnard College, fordi der er så meget bureaukrati i Amerika. Ingen ville rigtig tage ansvar i telefonen.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det var okay. Men det var meget hårdt de første to uger, fordi du var nødt til at møde op til alle de timer, du gerne ville nå at prøve.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: At søge på CUlpa omkring fagene og lærerne for at danne et overblik omkring, hvad tidligere studerende i de kurser har sagt.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det var meget filmpraktiskefag på Undergraduate niveau.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Der er mange flere læsninger, som man skal bevise man har læst ved at lave et diskussionsafsnit man sender til læreren inden hver undervisningsgang. Desuden er der mange flere løbende opgaver end der er på KU, som alle sammen tæller med i din endelige karakter. Det føltes lidt som at gå på gymnasiet igen i forhold til deltagelse og så videre.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
- Museums of New York City
- Digital Production
- Lab in Fiction Filmmaking
- Intro to the Moving Image 
- Fiction Filmmaking

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Museums of New York City og Intro to the Moving Image. Museums og New York City er en god mulighed for at få besøgt nogle museer man ellers ikke ville få set og bare opleve byens kulturliv. Intro to the Moving Image var super fedt, fordi man skulle lave enormt mange små opgaver med filmmediet på forskellige måder.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Sidst på semestret var det meningen at min kæreste skulle komme at besøge mig, men på grund af hele situationen med Columbia Universitys demonstrationer var det ikke længere tilladt at have gæster. Så vi måtte smide 12.000 kr. for et hotel i 3 nætter.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Supermarkedsvarer er koloenormt dyre.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Sport, træningscenter, tegning, maling, filmklub - You name it!

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Pilates

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Se turistattraktioner og musseer. Oplev også biografen. Vi tog en smuttur til Miami og Washington og det var også bare ret fedt at opleve andre dele af USA.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Nemt nok. På mange måder minder det om København i en meget forstørret udgave.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Nej. Det eneste er bare at amerikanere er lidt sværere at komme helt ind under huden på. De er mega velkommende.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Museer!

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Begynd tidligt at kigge ordentligt på fag, vær åbensindet overfor dine roommates selvom de måske ikke gør rent og er lidt irriterende, brug tid på dine lektier - det gør undervisningen nemmere og sjovere, ligesom dine medstuderende for lidt mere respekt og gerne vil arbejde sammen og en god måde at få venner.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Jeg har lært at tale engelsk meget bedre og jeg synes også jeg har lært en masse.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At skulle navigere i kaos.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
